query: So my car got towed, what now?
reference_answer:
Towed Away Vehicle:
If your vehicle is towed away, contact the nearest Traffic Police station or the towing company to locate your vehicle. You will need to produce your vehicle's registration documents and pay any applicable fines or towing charges to retrieve your vehicle.
answer: If your car was towed, contact the towing company to arrange for its pick-up. Check if there's a fee and ensure you understand the terms of the tow. Follow up with the towing company to confirm when your vehicle will be released. [Document 1]
